name: 22nd INEBRIA Conference 2026
organizer: International Network on Brief Interventions for Alcohol and Other Drugs
description: The International Network on Brief Interventions for Alcohol and Other Drugs holds its 22nd conference at the Karolinum Centre in Prague, Czech Republic from October 14 to 16, 2026. The conference covers brief interventions for alcohol and other drug use across addiction medicine, psychiatry, and public health, with capacity for about 150 participants and no conference fee.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission opens
deadlines.note: Opening of the combined pre-registration and abstract submission window; up to two abstracts per participant across oral, symposia, workshop, poster, and innovative formats.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission deadline
deadlines.note: Extended deadline for the pre-registration and abstract submission window.

sources.note: Confirms dates (October 14 to 16, 2026), Karolinum Centre venue in Prague, fully in person format, no conference fee, approximate 150 person capacity, and the abstract submission window (February 18 to April 29, 2026).
